card.name: Modifier before an expected noun
card.fires_on: Adjectives or modifiers such as proper, recommended, normal, initial, daily, and more that sit just before the noun they describe. The noun is predictable, for example position, dose, saline, or studies.

modes.label: Modifier before dose or treatment noun
modes.description: An adjective like recommended, initial, daily, or normal comes right before a dose or fluid term.
modes.example: the maximum recommended human<< daily>> dose (MRHDD) when compared

modes.label: Comparative after a comma
modes.description: The word more follows a comma and precedes an adjective describing studies or methods.
modes.example: paves the way for further,<< more>> detailed studies of exoplanets.

modes.label: Early inside a phrase
modes.description: The first part of the word early appears in an all-caps heading.
modes.example: IN UNDIAGNOSED EAR<<LY>> HIV-1 INFECTION Severe
